svg.text: OXYGEN DIFFUSES INTO THE BLOOD, CARBON DIOXIDE DIFFUSES OUT, IN THE ALVEOLI

g.text: Many alveoli, so more gas diffuses
2. Lactic acid builds up, causing fatigue
3. Oxygen debt is the extra oxygen

svg.text: The trachea has cartilage rings and a ciliated lining; the cilia sweep mucus and trapped dust up to the throat.
